CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2018 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2018 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 586 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: March 2018 to March 2018). These surveys captured 243 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 6 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 533 cards across 49 sites, with 28.7% showing evidence of mouse activity (153 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 209 transects across 49 sites (survey period: March 2018 to April 2018), detecting active burrows in 59.3% of transects (total: 519 active burrows).
